title: Guardoc Health processes clinical documentation using Amazon Nova models
slides: Your docs pile up—what if AI could read them?
Guardoc uses Amazon Nova to parse clinical notes.
It extracts findings humans might overlook entirely.
Your team now reviews flagged insights, not raw text.
Start with one chart—compare what you missed.
thread_text:
1. What if AI read your docs?

Doctors overlook up to 30% of clinical findings. Guardoc catches them.

2. It parses notes with Amazon Nova.

The AI scans unstructured text, not just coded data. It finds patterns humans skip.

3. Your team sees flagged insights.

No more reading raw files. The tool extracts only what needs review.

4. Start with one chart.

Compare what you missed against the AI's picks. The gap is measurable.

5. Try it on a single patient note today.

Do you know what you overlooked last week? Run one test and see.

instagram.caption:
Doctors miss up to 30% of clinical findings buried in plain text notes.  

Guardoc Health now uses Amazon Nova models to parse unstructured clinical documentation. It extracts patterns and overlooked data points from raw patient charts.  

Your team stops reading every line—the AI flags only the insights requiring review. You review what was missed, not what you already saw.  

Can you name the last finding your own notes hid from you? Run one chart through Guardoc and compare.
